property.name: Text 1
property.value: Once the heat is down, I can return home. The large flames block all movement and traffic.

property.name: Direction

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This is the Business Area. It lives up to its name. You pick a creed, and you stick together. But in this current situation, I'd suggest you take the quickest route home. The flames have appeared with the CopyNavi. They won't dissolve until the navi is deleted, so cleaning them is like drying clothes on a rainy day. Or shoveling amidst a storm - you get the picture. Business Area is huge. The Golden road is the fastest route out of here. There are, fortunately, a lot of alternate routes... But be wary, there are viruses around here. Use your Map appropriately to plan a route.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This is the Business Square. It's only relatively safe... What? Digi-World emitter? I've no clue what you-- OH yes! Uhh... It's not here. It's ... further ahead.

property.name: Direction

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'M THE SECURITY PROGRAM FOR THIS HOME PAGE. COME CLOSER, AND I WILL BREAK EVERY SINGLE LINE OF CODE IN YOUR FACE.
